hook: Inside an Alexandria home, authorities discovered 400 gold bars belonging to CIA officer David Rush.

sections.voiceover: Inside an Alexandria home, authorities discovered 400 gold bars belonging to CIA officer David Rush.
How did he hide the $200 million total fraud involving fake contracts and real estate deals?
But the trap was his $200 million scam, which funneled fake contracts into real estate.
Rush pleaded guilty to a $195 million fraud involving those gold bars and real estate. Federal authorities in Washington now demand restitution for the $195 million stolen.
The CIA confirms this is the largest financial fraud ever committed by one member.
